name: SS - FC Spotlight
description: Dramatic dark-themed featured collection with a large center-stage spotlight product and a horizontal carousel of supporting products beneath. The spotlight product features cinematic lighting effects, glassmorphism price tag, and animated badge. The carousel supports drag scrolling, snap points, and auto-play. Configurable spotlight size, carousel speed, product details visibility, and rich color customization. Ideal for electronics, luxury goods, and premium product showcases.
